name: storage-gateway-health
description: Runs deep health checks on AWS Storage Gateway (File, Volume, and Tape) - gateway VM CPU, memory, and state; cache and upload-buffer utilization and eviction; network throughput to AWS against the bandwidth rate limit; iSCSI, NFS, and SMB mount stability; and working-storage exhaustion - and produces preventive maintenance recommendations before cases reopen. Read-only and recommend-only. Recommends the AWS Documentation MCP, or a custom on-prem-appliance MCP, as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on FRI at 05:00 UTC
